title: The Three Paths Choice
next_chapter_hook: As Chen Ji fell into deep contemplation, two familiar voices suddenly pierced through the endless void—the calls of Su Qingyao and Ye Qing from beyond the shore of time, pointing him toward the final bonds that remained.

text.content: The void was filled with chaotic energy, as if the primordial wilderness before heaven and earth were created. Chen Ji stood alone at the crossroads of destiny, surrounded by countless flowing lights and shadows—fragments of past and future, weaving before his eyes into a shattered tapestry. At his feet, the Tianji Record Fragment emitted a faint glow, as if awaiting something.

dialogue.content: "Interesting." The voice came from all directions, calm to the point of cruelty, "For you to reach this far is one in ten thousand. Unfortunately, destiny never permits anyone to walk away unscathed."

text.content: Chen Ji raised his head sharply to see a figure slowly emerge from the void—an elderly man with snow-white hair, his ancient face as still as an undisturbed well, surrounded by countless star-like runes. His aura was profound and unfathomable, as if he stood above the heavenly way, yet also merged seamlessly with it. Cang Yutian, or the one known as the "Ultimate Chess Player," had finally revealed himself.

dialogue.content: "I have waited a long time," Cang Yutian's voice carried a trace of imperceptible weariness, "waiting for someone who could reach the final game. Chen Ji, you have not disappointed me. Now, let me tell you the truth of the three paths."

text.content: He waved his hand, and three screens of light slowly unfolded before Chen Ji. Within the first screen, a path leading toward light was clearly visible—that was the path of freedom, the path of liberation that Chen Ji had dreamed of.

dialogue.content: "Path A—Break the Chain of Causality. You need to gather all fragments of the Tianji Record, using the complete power of prophecy to tear apart the causal web woven by the heavenly way. The price: permanently forfeit the ability to write destiny, becoming an ordinary cultivator from now on. But you will survive, and those you cherish will survive."

text.content: Chen Ji's heart tightened sharply. Forfeit the ability to write destiny—that was his greatest reliance on this journey, and also his heaviest shackle. If it could exchange for true freedom, this path... seemed not unacceptable.

dialogue.content: "Path B—Become the New Heavenly Way." Cang Yutian's voice lowered slightly, "Gather the Tianji Record and fuse with the consciousness of the Destiny Writer. You will inherit everything it possesses, becoming the next existence towering above all beings. Power, immortality, endless possibilities... but you will no longer be Chen Ji."

text.content: No longer be Chen Ji—these words were like a blade, stabbing fiercely into Chen Ji's heart. He thought of Su Qingyao's cold and proud gaze, Ye Qing's bright smile, and that long-missed "Brother" from Chen Nian. If he were no longer Chen Ji, what meaning would those bonds have?

dialogue.content: "As for Path C..." Cang Yutian paused, a complex emotion flickering in his gaze, "Activate the self-destruction program of the Tianji Record, annihilating together with the heavenly will. The timeline collapses, everything returns to nothingness. No victor, no survivor, not even memories."

text.content: Chen Ji fell silent. Three paths lay before him, each strewn with thorns, each requiring a price he could not bear. Freedom requires forfeiting power, power requires losing oneself, destruction requires dragging everyone along. This was the final joke destiny played on him.

dialogue.content: "One more thing." Cang Yutian suddenly spoke, "Among the prices of Path C, there is one you do not yet know. To activate the self-destruction program, the life of your most cherished one must serve as the catalyst. Not sacrifice, but offering—her existence will become the key to detonate everything."

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. His most cherished ones—Chen Nian. Su Qingyao. Ye Qing. These names flashed repeatedly in his mind, each one making his heart feel like it was being cut by a blunt knife. The cruelty of destiny far exceeded his imagination.

Cang Yutian watched him quietly, his eyes showing no ripple, as if he had long seen through all of this: "Choose, ending or beginning, destruction or rebirth. Time is running out, the gaze of the Heavenly Eye is drawing near."

choice.prompt: The three paths lay before him, Cang Yutian's gaze like judgment. Chen Ji had to make a choice—this moment would determine the fate of all.

text.content: Chen Ji slowly closed his eyes, feeling the Tianji Record tremor one final time within him. The power being relinquished flowed away like sand through his fingers—that was his greatest reliance on this journey, now about to vanish.

dialogue.content: "Are you certain?" For the first time, a tremor appeared in Cang Yutian's voice, "Once you take this path, there is no possibility of turning back."

text.content: Chen Ji's hand hovered in mid-air, unable to descend. Power—that which he never dared to covet, now lay within reach. However, the price was losing everything, including those he had protected with all his might.

dialogue.content: "The taste of power..." A slight smile curved Cang Yutian's lips, "Are you certain you can resist it?"

text.content: Chen Ji's fingers trembled slightly. Destruction—this option he had never considered. Yet, when thinking of the suffering the Heavenly Eye brought to all beings, the fates it manipulated, his heart felt like falling into an icy abyss.

dialogue.content: "Destruction..." Cang Yutian's gaze was profound as an abyss, "This is the simplest, yet also the cruelest choice. Are you prepared?"

text.content: Just then, from the depths of the void, two faint yet steadfast voices suddenly came. Chen Ji raised his head sharply—it was Su Qingyao's cold and clear voice, piercing through layers of temporal barriers: "Chen Ji, whatever you choose, I stand behind you." Immediately following was Ye Qing's enchanting voice: "And me. We await your return."

The two voices were like thunderbolts, exploding in Chen Ji's heart. Their voices had traversed the barriers of time and space, bringing him the final bonds and hint. Su Qingyao's trust, Ye Qing's vigil—these were his only concerns in this cataclysm, and also the greatest bonds when he made his choice.
Cang Yutian quietly observed all this, and deep in his eyes, a trace of imperceptible envy seemed to flicker: "Is this the power of bonds? Interesting... Then, what is your choice?"

Chen Ji took a deep breath, embedding those two voices deep in his heart. The choice of destiny lay before him, and he must, between freedom, power, and destruction, select a path that belongs to himself. No matter what lay ahead, he would not regret—for this time, the choice was finally in his own hands.

However, just then, a low rumble suddenly came from the depths of the void. The gaze of the Heavenly Eye was drawing near, and time for Chen Ji was running out. He had to decide quickly, or everything would lose its meaning.

Su Qingyao and Ye Qing's voices gradually dissipated in the void, but the warmth and strength they brought were seared like a brand into Chen Ji's heart. He knew that whatever choice he made, it was not for himself—but for those waiting for his return from beyond the shore of time. At this moment, he finally understood what "worthy" meant.
